volume.title: Traveler
volume.author: Cuttlefish That Loves Diving
volume.title_meaning: This time, the title does not refer to Klein's Pathway, but is about Klein's travels as he moves from place to place in the sea. As a traveler, he gets involved with various people's lives and interacts with many things, but simultaneously, he keeps an aloof distance befitting that of a traveler. In addition, traveler also refers to how the idea of people traveling in search of home, sojourning, yet not having truly arrived. This can be seen with the characters in Groselle's Travels, as well as the souls stored in Creeping Hunger.
volume.synopsis: Klein traveled to the Sonia Sea under the identity of Gerhman Sparrow, a crazy adventurer seeking fortune on the sea. He took the ship from Pritz Harbor to Bayam. Along the way, he met Danitz, the fourth boatswain of the Golden Dream, whom he 'captured' and treated as his servant. They passed Bansy Harbor during the trip, at the same time, an old custom in Bansy Harbor was revived. Some of the inhabitants became heretics and were corrupted. This place was later known to be where the descendants of Medici reside. During his time in Bayam, Klein took many opportunities acting as a Faceless, that is, pretending to be another person and convincing the audience. Klein and Danitz visited the Resistance, a local resistance army to look for mystical items. After Klein touched a bone dagger, the Sea God Kalvetua attempted to take over his body but failed. Klein then informed the Church of the Lord of Storms, which killed Kalvetua. Klein took the Sea God Scepter, which gave Klein the authority of Kalvetua and made himself the new Sea God. After killing Mithor King, the third mate of Vice-Admiral of Ailment Tracy, the name of the crazy adventurer Gehrman Sparrow finally spread over the Rorsted Archipelago. Later Klein was hired as Darkwill's bodyguard to protect him from the Die of Probability's influence and traveled to deliver it to Oravi Island. On Oravi Island, Klein was hired to fake himself as Admiral Amyrius Rieveldt for three days. This job was actually plotted by Mother Tree of Desire who noticed Klein's uniqueness and wanted to corrupt him. In order to promote to sequence 5, Klein asked a new member of the Tarot Club, Admiral of Stars Cattleya to bring him to the Sea of Ruins and search for the mermaids. Cattleya agreed and they started the journey towards the Sea of Ruins. During this journey, he met Bernadette Gustav, Frank Lee and Anderson Hood, entered a dream world that connects to the Giant King's Court, and successfully promoted to sequence 5. Sometime later, the Vice Admiral Iceberg of the Golden Dream mysteriously disappeared on her flagship. Danitz wrote to Klein for help. Klein found out that she was sucked into Groselle's Travels. Klein, Danitz and Anderson entered the book, killed the final boss, the ice dragon Ulyssan, and escaped with others who were sucked into the book before. Though these people died immediately after they left the book because they have stayed in the book for too long. Mother Tree of Desire, or Rose School of Thought, found traces of Klein again and attempted to catch him before Klein leaves Bayam. This led to a chaotic fight that blew up a nearby mountain peak. Klein eventually escaped from the battlefield with the help of Reinette Tinekerr and Mr. Azik. Meanwhile, Jahn Kottman, the Archbishop of Rorsted Sea from Church of Lord of Storms came after the fight. After learning what happened, he put Gehrman Sparrow on the Wanted list, with a bounty of 50k pounds. Klein who successfully escaped and gained the Admiral of Blood Senor to his marionette, decided to return to Backlund. While planning to steal the Antigonus Family's Notebook from Saint Samuel Cathedral for a Sequence 4 potion formula.

timeline_of_major_events.event: Tarot Club 27th meeting.

Klein bought a ticket for the White Agate to go to Bayam. Klein learned about canned wolf-fish. Leonard attended the Hermits of Fate gathering. Ikanser Bernard and the Machinery Hivemind analyzed the Great Smog of Backlund and Sherlock Moriarty.

Machinery Hivemind investigated the information from Sherlock Moriarty via Arrodes. Klein's pseudonym: Gehrman Sparrow boarded the White Agate. Klein, Cleves, and others hunted Murloc. Colin's exploration team returned to the City of Silver.
The White Agate arrived at Damir Harbor. Klein first met Danitz. Klein wanted to use the White Shark to catch the Admiral of blood Senor.

Danitz boarded the White Agate and became Klein's servant. The White Agate arrived at Bansy Harbor. An old custom in Bansy Harbor was revived. Klein and Danitz rescued the passengers and Elland. Bishop Millet was killed.
Tarot Club 28th meeting. Fors fully digested the second Apprentice potion.
The White Agate arrived in Bayam. Danitz was hunted by Steel Maveti. Klein rescued Danitz. Audrey promoted to the Psychiatrist.
Alger met Danitz at the bar. Klein and Alger's meeting.
Klein and Danitz hunted Steel Maveti and his companions. Klein went to Symeem Island. On the way back, he passed by Leticia Dolera and her party.

Danitz's bounty increased to 4,200 pounds. Vice Admiral Iceberg entered Danitz's dream. Klein noticed and entered Danitz's dream as well, he negotiated to cooperate with Edwina. Danitz brought Klein to the Resistance. Klein was eroded by the Sea God Kalvetua, then he tackled Kalvetua with the grey fog.

Sea God Kalvetua went mad and tried to create tsunami but got suppressed by Jahn Kottman. Fors promoted to the Trickmaster. Official Beyonders found Laticia and her party, they obtained the Book of Calamity.
Kalvetua died. Klein obtained the Sea God Scepter and responded to the believers.
Arrodes connected Klein's telegram. Audrey heard the legend of the dragon in East Chester County. At night, she saw the mind dragon in the subconscious sea.
Danitz's bounty increased to 5,500 pounds. Klein encountered Nast Solomon in the Spirit World.
Reinette Tinekerr became Klein's messenger.
Klein and Danitz participated in a Beyonder gathering at the Amyris Leaf Bar of Bayam at night. Cattleya joined the Tarot Club.
Tarot Club 29th meeting. Cattleya told Bernadette that someone was collecting Roselle's Diary. Danitz invited Klein to meet Edwina Edwards.

Klein asked Helene the questions about Vice-Admiral of Ailment Tracy. Klein disguised himself as Helene and boarded on the Black Death. Klein failed to assassinate Tracy, jumped into the sea, and fled.

Klein returned to Bayam and wrote a letter to Azik, informing the latter about a batch of documents related to the ancient chronicles of Death in the hands of Tracy. Derrick promoted to the Solar High Priest. Klein bought the medicine from Darkwill. Darkwill entrusted Klein to find his teacher, Roy King. Klein and Azik boarded on the Black Death. They met Katarina Pelle. Katarina agreed to hand the documents to Azik.
Klein heard about the Snake of Mercury from Arrodes. Alger promoted to the Wind-blessed.
Emlyn promoted to the Potions Professor. Tarot Club 30th meeting.
Klein kills Mithor King and Ozil, the owner of the Amyris Leaf Bar. Darkwill hired Klein as a three-days bodyguard to bring the Die of Probability to Oravi Island.
The Amyris Leaf Bar had a new owner. Darkwill brought his Beyonder pet owl, Mr. Harry.

Cattleya's twenty-seventh birthday. Fors observed Williams Street and while examining Medici's former location, saw an increase of foreign spies from Feysac and Intis. Klein entrusted Emlyn to contact Leonard tomorrow after knowing from Arrodes about Leonard's grandpa.

Botis came after the All-Black Eye, Klein used the Die of Probability to lift the crisis. Emlyn visited Leonard to buy the Tinder. Klein and Darkwill arrived at Oravi Island. Mother Tree of Desire gave Flight Ken a dream revelation, to kill a tramp and gave the Proliferation Necklace to Cynthia.
Emlyn bought the Tinder from Leonard. Susie promoted to the Psychiatrist.

Klein met Bilt Brando of the Adventurer Association. Flight Ken killed the tramp scheduled to temporarily work as Amyrius Rieveldt's stand-in. The Naturism Sect used the Proliferation Necklace and the tramp's hair to induce by Ritualistic Magic insatiable gluttony.
Tarot Club 31st meeting.

Klein volunteered to wash the toilet. Klein accepted the task issued by Bilt to be a stand-in to represent Amyrius Rieveldt for three days, meeting him two days later. Official Beyonders blew up the Fourth Epoch underground structure in Williams Street.

Klein met Aston Rieveldt, and was long-ranged confronted in the mind state by a member of the Twilight Hermit Order. Derrick was questioned by Colin about his sequence Solar High Priest and was assigned an exploration mission about two months (70+2 days) from now.
Klein spent a day meticulously acting as Amyrius. Cynthia prayed to the Mother Tree of Desire in private and in her sleep.

Klein fully understood Amyrius' psyche and had Aston, who left the governor-general post, sent back to Backlund to protect him. Klein was influenced by the passive aura of the Mother Tree of Desire, initiating a weird and embarrassing precognition at night. His contract with Amyrius restrained his desire. Cynthia mutated by a pseudo Mid-Sequence Boon and was killed by Klein. Klein interrogated Flight Ken of the low-level Naturism Sect. Klein used an excuse to prevent Amyrius from appearing in public for the next two days. Klein received Amyrius at midnight and left.

Klein went to the Sweet Lemon Bar to receive the Murloc Cufflink and 500 pounds from Bilt. Amyrius wanted Bilt to investigate the people around him the adventurer for Naturism Sect believers and sink them all into the sea. Klein went to the Oravi Hospice Foundation do volunteer work under the name 'Sinbad Volentier'. Bilt handled two Naturism Sect believers among his close aides. Leonard Mitchell's twenty-sixth birthday occurred on the next day.
Klein's twenty-third birthday.
Xio Derecha's twenty-second birthday.
Alger's thirty-second birthday.

The Tarot Club 32nd-41st meetings were unmentioned. During two months, Audrey and Alger were digesting their potions, Psychiatrist and Wind-blessed, thoroughly. After two months of volunteer work and finding four chances to engage in true acting, Klein bade farewell to carrying patients, scrubbing toilet bowls, cleaning vomit, and other miscellaneous chores. At a Tarot Club (35th/36th) meeting in early March, Klein had hired The Hermit Cattleya to board her ship and would meet her at the capital of Gargas Archipelago.

Fors' twenty-fourth birthday. Before disembarking on Nas, Klein tried and suffered from canned wolf-fish. Klein met Cattleya at Nas, the capital of the Gargas Archipelago to board her ship, The Future, to find the mermaid. Derrick prepared for the exploration mission assigned to him nearly 70 days ago. Lead by Colin, the team will head out two days later to do a second sweep of Afternoon Town. Klein met 'Poison Expert' Frank Lee on Cattleya's ship.
Young Sanguines accepted the mission to hunt Primordial Moon's believers. Audrey prayed to the Fool for a magic mirror divination in order to study the notebook from the Twenty-Year War.

Dorian Gray gave the Astrologer potion formula and Leymano's Travels to Fors. The Future entered the Sea of Ruins. 1st dream: Klein met Anderson Hood. Anderson boarded on the Future. 2nd dream: Klein met Leomaster and Saint of Darkness in the prison. The Black Tulip attacked the Future. Klein completely digested the Faceless potion.

3rd dream: Klein met Bernadette Gustav. Klein promoted to the Marionettist. The City of Silver arrived at the Afternoon Town. Derrick discovered the name of the founders of the Rose Redemption. 4th dream: Klein guessed Bernadette's identity and told her the password of the Black Emperor Card of Blasphemy.

The Devil pathway's Sequence 4 is Demon. Klein and Anderson left the Future. Will Auceptin's dream reveals that Sequence 4 is the Bizarro Sorcerer and higher Seer formulas come only from Zaratul or Hornacis Mountain.
Tarot Club 42st meeting. Slaughterer Kircheis was killed and grazed by Klein. Edwina was sucked into the Groselle's Travels.
Derrick's fifteenth birthday.

The Golden Dream crews discovered the disappearance of their captain, Edwina Edwards. Danitz sent a letter asking Gehrman Sparrow for help. Danitz, Klein and Anderson entered the Groselle's Travels to rescue Edwina. Danitz prayed to the Fool, he became the first believer of the Fool. Epic fight against Ulyssan.

Emlyn hired Ian to find Worshipers of the Primordial Moon. Klein and Anderson left the Golden Dream. Klein bought the Death Knell from Anderson's friend. Elland Kag mentioned the Crazy Captain Connors Viktor to Klein.

Klein found Connors Viktor. However, Connors was utterly silenced by Qonas Kilgor from MI9. Alger accepted the mission to investigate Gehrman Sparrow and Connors Viktor from the Church. Tarot Club 43rd meeting. Klein explores the Groselle's Travels. The military searched for Odell and Turani von Helmosuin. Orange Light Hilarion came to introduce himself and reminded Klein to be wary of the Mother Tree of Desire. Helmosuin's insight reveals Klein's connection to the divine 'gray fog' is visible to higher beings. He wonders if he's the 'ruler' himself, but concludes he's likely one of that being's chosen oracles — similar to Emperor Roselle.
Main Page: Chaos on Bayam Mountain. Ince Zangwill appeared at the ruins of Bansy Harbor.
Klein returned to Backlund in the identity of Dwayne Dantès. Klein successfully fulfilled Davy Raymond promise about his daughter, Neelu Raymond.
